narrative.headline: Compare regional tabiwa catalog products with payment units and original restriction evidence.
narrative.value_prop: Inspect published catalog summaries and requested-date membership. Full ticket terms, route coverage and stock remain unknown; finish on the canonical product page.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public catalog reads need no login. The only sent cookie is the documented regionId display preference. Queue-it full detail pages are excluded from runtime access.

quickstart.comment: Start with a bounded dated catalog shortlist.

troubleshoots.symptom: Source queue, HTML challenge or network error
troubleshoots.fix: Stop and use the canonical browser link; do not retry around access controls.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for tabiwa regional transport/attraction bundles and coupons, points-only prices, overview restriction evidence and saved catalog shortlists.
anti_triggers: Do not use for bookings, payments, purchased tickets, rewards balances or redemption actions.
Do not infer real availability, full redemption policies, included routes or savings from catalog labels.
